description: The control of nested-priority-chain, with y → B alone. y cannot read C, so leaving out [K] after it is permitted, and so is leaving out [V] after the empty [K]. z reads C K, and begins of r holds (engine §4).
grammar:
%rule text B C K
%conditions begins(from($), r)
%rule r y [+K] [+V] z
%rule y B
%rule z C K
